about: Java reference vectors for the call signalling/key plane. All binary values lowercase hex. 'wire' fields are the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the whole object INCLUDING sg. Resolutions of spec ambiguities are listed in rschat-docs/analysis/C182_JAVA_REFERENCE_STATUS_2026-10-07.md.

fixtures.seed_rule: seed(name) = SHA3-256(ASCII("tkm-call/v1/vectors/" + name)); Ed25519 identity keys are RFC 8032 keys from seed("identity/<name>")

group2_hashes.rule: call_id = H("tkm-call/v1/id" || canonical(create)); era_hash = H("tkm-call/v1/era" || canonical(record)); ann_hash = H("tkm-call/v1/ann" || canonical(announce)); H = SHA3-256, canonical without sg, no separator

group3_hybrid_combiner.mlkem: ML-KEM-768 FIPS 203: ek/dk = KeyGen_internal(mlkem_d, mlkem_z), (ss_k, ct) = Encaps_internal(ek, encaps_m)

group4_chain_ratchet.note: seq counts per direction over the channel's life and is not reset when k advances: owner>bob seq 0 = channel open, 1 = leave commit (k=0), 2 = era commit (k=1)

units.rule: KID = leg_index*65536 + (epoch mod 65536), RFC 9605 compact header; base_key = sender_base_e; unit = clear prefix || header || ct || tag; AAD = header || clear prefix

h264.note: per-NAL units behind the 1-byte NAL header with emulation-prevention escaping are not specified precisely enough yet; the SPS/PPS case falls to the spec's fallback (in clear) because libwebrtc's receive depacketizer parses them before any transformer runs

group8_negative.what: chat signature (Ed25519 over canonical JSON, no tkm-call prefix) presented as a call object
call signature verified as a chat signature: Ed25519.verify(f, sg, canonical(obj)) without the prefix
non-ASCII char in a signed field; sg valid over the Java low-8-bit octets, still MUST be refused
reordered payload: create.inv reversed, sg unchanged
reordered payload: commit.roster reversed, sg unchanged
type confusion: a mute object relabelled t=unmute keeps its sg
audience: the owner>bob channel open verified by carol's leg
context: a valid announce presented where a goodbye is expected
announcement validly signed, mlkem key fails the FIPS 203 encapsulation-key (modulus) check: the announcement verifier MUST refuse it
group8_negative.ek_source: ACVP ML-KEM-768 encapsulationKeyCheck tcId 137 (noisy linear system values too large)

group8_negative.what: positive control: the same announce with keys in reverse order on the wire still verifies
